'''Hsskhor''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. At the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], it was the site of the [[Battle of Hsskhor]], after the battle the city was razed to the ground. Over time it would be rebuilt and it would be the location of the [[Hsskhor Tally-house Meeting Halls]], within which peace talks between the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were held prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the Clone Wars, the planet itself played an important role, as negotiation stirred up between [[Bant Eerin's Padawan]] and then War Chief [[Raikhssa]] for Trandosha and its militia to stay way from part-taking in the conflict. Hsskhor was also the location of the magnificent [[Warlord's Palace]].
